Name: Living with Conviction: Sentenced to Debt for Life in Washington State Exhibit
Summary: An exhibit examining how Washington courts impose lifetime debt through legal financial obligations, using storytelling and community conversation.
Description:
Sunday, September 27, 2026, 10am - 6pm

This exhibitconfronts how Washington courts have been sentencing people not only to prison but also to a lifetime of debt.

Location Link:

Central Library

Room Location: Level 8 - Gallery

Registration Required: Registration is not required.

Detailed Description: "Living with Conviction: Sentenced to Debt for Life in Washington State" confronts how Washington courts have been sentencing people not only to prison but also to a lifetime of debt. The project leverages multimedia storytelling and community conversations to raise awareness about and advocate for an end to crippling court-imposed costs, fees, fines, and restitution, commonly referred to as Legal Financial Obligations, or LFOs. "Living with Conviction: Sentenced to Debt for Life in Washington State," goes beyond polarizing headlines and statistics, shining a light on this injustice by sharing stories of our common humanity., Thanks to our partner

Living with Conviction ., Thanks to our sponsor

The Seattle Public Library Foundation .

Event Logistics: The gallery is open during Central Libray's open hours., Living with Conviction is a 501\(c\)\(3\) nonprofit that works to secure economic and racial justice with and by marginalized communities, especially formerly incarcerated, through community-driven research, storytelling, and legal empowerment strategies., This exhibit runs through September 27, 2026, Learn more about

Exhibits .

Name: Run with the Fishes
Summary: A community 5K and 10K run celebrating the return of salmon, with a kids' fun run.
Description: Celebrate the Return of Issaquah Rotary Club's Run With The Fishes! Join us this fall for a cherished Issaquah tradition! The Issaquah Rotary Club's Run With the Fishes is back-featuring a 5K, 10K, and a 1K Kids' Fun Run-and we can't wait to run, cheer, and celebrate with you! For more than 30 years, the Rotary Run was a beloved part of Salmon Days, bringing runners of all ages through the heart of Issaquah as we celebrate the Fall return of the salmon to the Issaquah Creek. After a hiatus since 2019, we were thrilled to announce the return of the race in 2025-with a new location and racecourse that follows the Lake Sammamish State Park waterfront and parallels the Issaquah Creek so our participants can literally "Run With The Fishes" as they return to their spawning grounds this Fall. As an added benefit this year, we are bringing back the Rotary Club's iconic long sleeved event running shirt to go along with this Fall classic event. 5K/10K/1K Kids' Run Date: Sunday, September 27, 2026 Location: Lake Sammamish State Park - 2182 NW Sammamish Rd., Issaquah WA \(Important! A Discover Pass is needed for this event.\) Time: Registration begins at 7:30 A.M. Fee: Early Registration By July 31st - $45 August 1st through Race Day - $50 1K Fun Run \(with tee shirt\) - $20 For more information go to the website www.issaquahrunwiththefishes.com We'll see you on the course!
Short: The event is held on September 27, 2026 at Lake Sammamish State Park in Issaquah, WA.The cost is 20.00 - 50.00
